node.title: Sub-k support canonicalization alone leaves a large interpolation fiber
node.statement: For an n-point Reed-Solomon evaluation set, a received word U, and a fixed r-point support R with r<k, exactly q^(k-r) degree-<k polynomials agree with U on R, and at least q^(k-r)-(n-r)q^(k-r-1) have exact agreement set R. Therefore the open sub-k clause of petal_g3_pricing_multiplicity cannot follow from canonical support deduplication alone; a valid charging datum must retain additional independent petal/cofactor constraints or couple the residual freedom to a separately paid profile.
